entities.name: sign regulations
entities.description: Rules and guidelines governing the installation, size, placement, and design of signs within the city to ensure safety, aesthetics, and compliance with local laws.

entities.name: zoning code
entities.description: Legal framework that defines land use, building standards, and development regulations within different zones of the city to guide urban growth and land utilization.

entities.name: compliance requirements
entities.description: Specific standards and procedures that individuals and businesses must follow to adhere to city laws, including sign regulations, zoning laws, and other municipal codes.

entities.name: real estate signs
entities.description: Signs used for advertising properties for sale or lease, including regulations on size, placement, and duration to ensure proper marketing and neighborhood aesthetics.

entities.name: walkability
entities.description: The measure of how friendly an area is to walking, considering sidewalk quality, safety, accessibility, and proximity of amenities to promote pedestrian activity.

entities.name: parking
entities.description: Regulations, availability, and management of parking facilities within the city to support transportation needs and urban mobility.
